title: Children at Swimming Pool, 1959 Vintage B&W Snapshot
description: A square black and white snapshot with decorative scalloped edges captured in June 1959. The photo depicts two young toddlers, handwritten at top as 'Sandy & Bobby' aged '27 mo', sitting side by side on the concrete edge of an outdoor swimming pool. A head of another swimmer is visible floating in the background pool water, with a cinder block wall and arid hills in the background.
